assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The monitoring is ordered to detect arrhythmic events
The monitoring is ordered to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the documented arrhythmias
The service is medically necessary to prevent recurrent ischemic events
The patient has a history of cerebrovascular disease
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I49.5
The diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome is coded as I48.0
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
